description: Collapsed wing of a regional hospital. Medical supplies may remain in sealed rooms.
A stripped roadside station. Fuel drums and scrap metal scattered across the lot.
Intact house in a low-density neighborhood. Pantry, tools, maybe a working stove.
Sealed military installation. High-value supplies behind heavy doors.
A sealed pre-war storage locker in a collapsed residential block. Coordinates from a stranger. Real or a trap — you won't know until you're there.
